name: 진영

tips.주어-동사: a lot of, one of, several 뒤에는 복수명사 + s 발음 또렷하게: places, hobbies, reasons.
tips.관사·전치사: near + 명사(near my house), nearby는 단독(a café nearby).
tips.단어 선택: 걸어서는 on foot(by walk ❌). 트레이닝복은 sweatpants·sweatshirt. passionate about / a passion for.
tips.문장 구조: 주어를 '나(I)'로 바꾸면 쉬워져요: I enjoyed it.
tips.발음·철자: 조금 더 크게, 정확하게 말하기. 복수 s 발음 확실히!

focus.1: 가장 쉬운 방법으로, 문법 실수 없이! Part 3는 straightforward하게: 답 → 근거 → 예시. 연결어 공부하기.
focus.2: To give you some background 다음엔 배경 1~2문장 먼저 붙이기.
focus.3: How often 질문엔 more often than not, from time to time 등으로 바꿔 말하기.

compare: near + 명사: near my house · nearby 단독: a café nearby
I'm passionate about + 명사/-ing · I have a passion for + 명사

cards.ko: 잘 모르겠어요. 사실 별로 관심이 없었어요.
cards.en: I don't really know. To be honest, I've never been very interested in it.
cards.gram: 아이엘츠는 가장 쉬운 방법으로! '모릅니다'도 좋은 답이에요. 짧게 솔직하게 + 한 문장 더.

cards.ko: 우리 집 근처에 공원이 있어요. 근처에 카페도 있어요.
cards.en: There's a park near my house, and there's a café nearby.
cards.gram: near + 명사(near my house), nearby는 단독으로(a café nearby).

cards.ko: 우리 도시에는 가 볼 만한 곳이 많아요.
cards.en: There are a lot of places to visit in my city.
cards.gram: a lot of + 복수명사, 끝의 s 발음을 확실하게!
cards.mine: There are a lot of place …

cards.ko: 그 도시는 아름다운 해변으로 잘 알려져 있어요.
cards.en: The city is well known for its beautiful beaches.
cards.gram: be well known for ~ = ~로 잘 알려져 있다.

cards.en: I've eaten worse.
cards.gram: I've eaten worse. = 그 정도면 괜찮아요(더 별로인 것도 먹어 봤다).

cards.ko: 그 책은 생각할 거리를 많이 줬어요.
cards.en: The book gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.gram: food for thought = 생각할 거리.

cards.en: The portions are generous at that restaurant.
cards.gram: The portions are generous / small. = 양이 많다 / 적다.

cards.en: I'm particularly fond of Italian food.
cards.gram: 좋아한다 바꿔 말하기: I'm really into / I'm crazy about / I'm particularly fond of / I'm a big fan of.

cards.en: We hit it off right away.
cards.gram: hit it off = 처음부터 죽이 잘 맞다.

cards.en: Price-wise, it's quite reasonable.
cards.gram: 명사 + -wise = ~ 면에서.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute bus ride.
cards.gram: It's a 10-minute drive / bus ride / walk / subway ride. minute은 단수!

cards.en: I go to school on foot.
cards.gram: 걸어서는 on foot. by walk ❌

cards.en: I usually wear sweatpants and a sweatshirt at home.
cards.gram: '트레이닝복'은 콩글리시: sweatpants(하의), sweatshirt(상의).

cards.en: One of my hobbies is cooking.
cards.gram: one of + 복수명사(hobbies), 동사는 is.

cards.ko: 커피 마시는 게 잠을 깨는 가장 좋은 방법이에요.
cards.en: Drinking coffee is the best way to wake myself up.
cards.gram: wake myself up = 잠을 깨우다. make myself up ❌

cards.en: I'm passionate about music. I have a passion for music.
cards.gram: passionate about + 명사/-ing (형용사) · have a passion for + 명사 (명사).

cards.ko: 배경을 조금 말씀드리자면, 저는 그때 고등학생이었어요.
cards.en: To give you some background, I was in high school at the time.
cards.gram: To give you some background, 다음엔 바로 이유로 가지 말고 배경 1~2문장을 먼저!

cards.en: The food there is a bit pricey.
cards.gram: pricey = 비싼(expensive의 구어체).

cards.en: I really enjoyed the job.
cards.gram: 주어를 '나(I)'로 바꿔 말하면 문장이 쉬워져요: It was enjoyable → I enjoyed it.

cards.ko: 그녀는 사람들을 가르치는 데 재능이 있어요.
cards.en: She has a gift for teaching people.
cards.gram: have a gift for + 명사/-ing = ~에 재능이 있다.

cards.en: I'm more productive in the morning.
cards.gram: productive = 생산적인.

cards.en: More often than not, I study at home.
cards.gram: How often 질문엔: more often than not · from time to time · every now and then · once in a blue moon · on and off.

cards.ko: 제가 그 일을 원하는 이유는 여러 가지예요.
cards.en: There are several reasons why I want that job.
cards.gram: Part 2 서론: several + 복수명사(reasons).

cards.en: Travelling broadens my horizons.
cards.gram: broaden one's horizons = 시야를 넓히다(horizons 복수).

cards.en: Many jobs will be replaced by AI.
cards.gram: be replaced by ~ = ~로 대체되다.

cards.en: It should be taken with a pinch of salt.
cards.gram: take something with a pinch of salt = 곧이곧대로 믿지 않다.

cards.en: These days, information is at our fingertips.
cards.gram: at one's fingertips = 손쉽게 얻을 수 있는.

cards.en: I took up yoga last year.
cards.gram: take up = (취미로) 시작하다.

cards.ko: 요리할 때 물 만난 물고기 같아요.
cards.en: I feel I'm in my element when I cook.
cards.gram: be in one's element = 물 만난 물고기 같다.

cards.en: I need to brush up on my English.
cards.gram: brush up on = 다시 익히다.
